$schema_description: Generic Slack OAuth config for yaas. Defines the scopes and PKCE flow. Per-install values (app_id, client_id, workspace) live in .env at the repo root — see .env.example. Used by setup.sh.
_reactions_read_note: reactions:read may require workspace admin approval in some orgs. If approval is required, request it before running setup.sh; or proceed without — the reaction-monitoring path in triage.sh will return zero results until the scope is granted, then each user re-runs setup.sh to re-authorize.
